text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so I pointed it at `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events; it now returns `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma", so I added it. The tests only pin its title, so I made up the author (Austen), year (1815) and copy count (1).
